about: Made-up calls with known verdicts, to measure a grader: `uv run check-grader --set`. Each transcript is made up; no caller's words are here. {owner} is the owner's name. The facts fit profile.md: when you change a fact there, change the calls that use it. `fail` names each model rule that must fail, with the agent at fault and the cause codes that are right. A rule that is not in `fail` must not fail. `na` names the rules that have no moment in the call. `feedback` names the kinds of feedback that the caller gave about the phone line itself ("fault", "idea"); a call with no `feedback` has none. Write a new call and its verdicts before you run a grader on it.
